changelog.body: Disable back gesture WA when "ad cards removal" is disabled.

**Changeslog:**
- Add preferences UI to make "background play back" and "ad cards removal" optional.
- Fix a YouTube Music crash: https://github.com/wanam/YouTubeAdAway/issues/131
- Fix the channel's community removal: https://github.com/wanam/YouTubeAdAway/issues/132
- The App settings may not stick at first install/update, just update them after reboot then force-stop YouTube App to reload the preferences.

Sources are available on https://github.com/wanam/YouTubeAdAway
This update comes with a workaround for the broken back-to-exit gesture.

- Merge brute force lookups
- Add more ad filters (based on revanced patches)
- Restore back to exit gesture
- Add Spanish language, thanks to @nmayorga092 and @jmunoz94

Tested against YouTube 18.02.34

Hide Ad cards, thanks to @Dev4Mod !
Open up YT hooks to other YouTube variants (Music, TV...), UNTESTED!

Support YouTube 17.42.+ and 17.43.+
Add FR translation
Add BTC address for development support.

Support of YouTube beta versions 17.41.xx.
Tested against YouTube 17.41.36

- Support YouTube 17.40.40
- Disable in-video ads
- Enable background playback

YouTube ad cards are NOT removed, I will try to find a way to hide those cards, but no ETA!
Feel free to contribute with pull requests.

readme:
# YouTubeAdAway
Xposed module to block YouTube in-video ads and enable background playback on the official YouTube app

Feel free to raise an issue if a newer YouTube update is not supported, and please make sure you provide your xposed logs.

You are more than welcome to contribute with pull requests!
